question: Does retaining only the native top-12 routes remove enough distractor/error contribution that uniform Budget16 becomes terminally viable at the known get_weather boundary?

intervention.definition: Both arms use the same uniform Budget16 policy. The candidate sets DFLASH_KIMI_EXPERIMENT_ROUTE_LIMIT=12; retained router weights are unchanged and omitted routes contribute zero. No schema or position rescue is enabled.
intervention.control: The route16 arm uses the native 16 routes with the same binary and policy.

gate.go: Route12/Budget16 must match the Budget24-reference top-1 with positive teacher-token margin, reduce KL(Budget24||arm) by at least 20% versus route16/Budget16, use fewer total provider bytes, and measure <=0.90 logical GiB/provider-position.
gate.no_go: If any condition fails, stop route12/Budget16 and do not spend a broad suite on it.
gate.next_if_go: Preregister one full get_weather generation with route12/Budget16 plus the already validated schema rescue. No broad suite until that passes.
gate.production: No production transplant from this discovery boundary.

limitations: Budget24 is a behaviorally successful reference, not native exact K3; the KL is reference-to-arm, not native terminal KL.
One prompt position tests a causal boundary but cannot establish broad reliability.
A global route count and uniform slab budget do not establish a layer-adaptive joint optimizer.
Retained route weights are not renormalized.
Cold token-sequential timing is not serving throughput.
